name: Catalogue tables, museums and the first data round
outcome: The reviewed pilot and museum joins raise museum-number coverage to 542 of 4,695 objects, while 1,146 excavation-table rows join the corpus.

name: Complete CISI basic-data transcription
outcome: The two tables contain 1,543 and 2,139 transcribed entries, with unresolved CISI 2 readings retained as candidate unions.

name: CISI 3 range coverage
outcome: The export contains 1,463 of 2,590 inferred number slots, leaving 1,127 absent slots whose object classes remain inferred from neighbours.

name: Images and dimension units
outcome: The index records 8,722 assets and 8,444 face-image links, retaining unresolved side assignments and dimension-unit flags.

name: Lothal and closing-sign plate checks
outcome: Two readers agree on the four-sign Lothal and M-895 text, while spacing distinguishes the stamps and M-895's animal remains unresolved.

name: Shared evaluation harness
outcome: Five task commands reproduce 50 numerical source comparisons, with historical population exposure retained in the shared split records.

name: Writing, publication and research displays
outcome: The prose pass checks 102 citations, the publication screen separates local-only files, and the website and 48-world renewal display expose existing results.

name: Outside review of structure and process
outcome: Three read-only Muse reviews assess repository layout, contributor rules and research direction.

name: Process repairs and newcomer route test
outcome: The route test completes metadata and reproduction tasks but records 28 obstacles; the motif pilot lowers recorded seal-motif coverage from 94.2% to 89.9%.

name: Fish order and the H-912 series
outcome: Fish order wins in 43 reserved groups against eight, while four tablet entries and the original 4–7-foot depth range constrain the H-912 reading.

name: Manufacture, deposition and regional variants
outcome: The source audit separates 40 vessel stamps, six tags and one stopper; adding city loses 0.01584 bits per target in the graphic-variant test.

name: Legend structure through excavated sequences
outcome: Both fixed-pattern conjectures die under their rules: Mohenjo-daro lacks predicted drift, while Harappa's length, inventory and variants change.

name: Observed line divisions and findspot maps
outcome: The segmenter reaches J = 0.718 on 33 faces with verified line order, and maps retain the earlier 1,430-seal population.

name: Foreign-script source and score audit
outcome: Corrected eligibility reduces the legacy contrast to 0.0536, with every family-bootstrap interval spanning zero and no verified foreign Wells-code transcription.

name: Fresh-material search and reserved collection
outcome: Farmana supplies 15 conditionally absent pottery objects but zero approved objects for the frozen seal tests, and Khirsara remains an acquisition target.

name: Contemporary civilisations
outcome: The comparison places the Mature Harappan civilisation beside 21 contemporary societies, retaining source-specific area, population and institution estimates.

name: Post-catalogue object census
outcome: The 503-row register identifies 301 post-catalogue inscribed objects and bounds corpus absence at 55–291 under the frozen join rule.

name: Birth-star naming calibration
outcome: Among 757 donor occurrences, 42 strict asterism names form a skewed class; five new predictions await fresh seals.

name: Dravidian root senses and northern initials
outcome: The star-sense reconstruction reaches root probability 0.524, while northern b- corresponds to Tamil v- in 50 of 55 comparisons and Tamil m- in 2 of 88.

name: Readable seal-legend corpora
outcome: The corpora contain 245 Indo-Aryan, 23 Tamil-Brahmi, 3,044 Ur III and 11 Akkadian eligible legends, leaving the frozen two-corpora-per-group test below its entry minimum.

name: Rebus interlock base rates
outcome: Matched random pairs reproduce the single interlock in 30.5% of cases, while the encoded four-link network occurs in 0.44% of draws.

name: Town axes, independent measurements and plan registration
outcome: The 29-town table fails the Pleiades version, while independent bearings, dates and failed Dholavira plan validation leave the broader orientation test unresolved.

name: Publication screen of the October 20 work
outcome: The screen examines 508 files with the earlier sequence scanner and records source-specific publication decisions.

name: Register, unit queues and reading-input repairs
outcome: The register preserves 4,695 objects and 5,680 faces, connects all 118 divided faces, and exposes lexical-prefix errors before a new reading comparison.

name: Face, lexical and identity review integration
outcome: The integration adds 5,474 review assertions, accepts 21 provisional spatial layouts and retains 306 candidate-only identity rows without physical merges.

name: Blind rebus templates and the Winslow rerun
outcome: Blind pairs yield 9 compounds among 38 pairs against 4.97 expected; the Winslow rerun fails its frozen rule because the starting interlock is absent.

name: Novelty review and findings presentation
outcome: The separate review identifies two existing scientific cores for focused papers and names the repairs needed for other publication candidates.

name: Eight-direction evidence programme, three passes
outcome: Three sets of eight source contributions recover context and identity chains, restricted lexical rules and documented conflicts, with separate checks of selected claims.

name: Dholavira object identities, three passes
outcome: Twenty-eight catalogue identities agree, but ten photographed targets retain 62 candidate families and 274 relationships with zero accepted corpus bridges.

name: Physical faces and missing-image sources, three passes
outcome: One recovered crop reduces the missing-face queue from 43 to 42, while eight provisional face bridges require further source adjudication.

name: Harappa contexts, three passes and review
outcome: H-1657 gains a late-3C floor attribution and H-1688 a Period 3A street key; the H-2587 lot conflict remains unresolved.

name: Lothal sealing supports, plate references and source verification
outcome: L-164's published jar-stopper and tentative box reconstructions differ, and Rao assigns its candidate photograph to two distinct excavation objects.

name: Tablet manufacture and use, three passes
outcome: The 22-tablet clump series shares a reported cutting method across at least three engravers, while the follow-ups recover no registered target-use relation.

name: Lexical extraction and grammatical evidence, three passes
outcome: Re-extraction changes the two-member table to 25,653 rows, and source review establishes restricted plant-compound am rules while scorer eligibility remains closed.

name: Readable-control acquisition, three passes
outcome: The Tell Brak catalogue resolves REG257 to catalogue 308 and TB1058, with zero new eligible legend admissions across the passes.

name: Third-pass source review
outcome: Twelve primary pages support the enumerated Harappa, Tell Brak, Tamil-grammar and Lothal source chains within a bounded reviewed scope.

name: Town axes, construction phases and visual records
outcome: The 34-town register retains 1,380 measurements and separate dating assertions, while construction-sample joins remain missing and displays expose the source differences.

name: Urban form and inscription ecology
outcome: The comparison records 287 urban assertions, but its follow-up finds zero fully qualified persistence episodes and zero matched documentary pairs.

name: Local storage preservation
outcome: The migration verifies 187,131 accessible files by hash and retains historical paths through nine junctions and 434 file links.

name: Crop continuity and transmission conjectures
outcome: Nine published phase summaries at five sites show crop persistence with changing proportions and motivate three untested transmission conjectures.

name: Twenty-target object pilot and independent review
outcome: Twenty dossiers preserve 539 inherited assertions and fourteen reviewed image-index relations, with two identity conflicts and zero physical merges.

name: Indus Atlas, reconstructions and later occupation
outcome: The atlas preserves 115 place entities, seven model scenes and source-qualified continuity comparisons without establishing an uninterrupted Indus-to-present town sequence.

name: Readable external records
outcome: Eight source pointers distinguish contemporary contact records from later comparisons, admitting zero inscriptions to an evaluation corpus.

name: Entry documentation cleanup
outcome: The entry documents link later source results and current conjecture tests, centralize storage guidance and record command-help checks.

name: Website organization
outcome: Seven navigation entries connect the themed findings, ideas and dated record while preserving the existing destinations.
